map.回收率上限？: Is there an upper limit to the recovery rate?
map.受组分与纯度限制，理论可回收比例外还有不可回收部分，目标设定需现实。结果按公开标: It is limited by composition and purity; beyond the theoretically recoverable share there is always a non-recyclable part, so targets must be realistic. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.和利用率区别？: How does it differ from the utilisation rate?
map.回收率是分出比例，利用率是真正再生利用比例，后者更反映实效。结果按公开标准与环境: The recovery rate is the share sorted out while the utilisation rate is the share actually reprocessed, which better reflects real performance. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
